targets.root_cause_statement: The complete paper and embedded supplement identify a fully relativistic LDA calculation in Quantum ESPRESSO but omit reproducibility-critical files and settings. The fitted V and psi parameters only define the downstream continuum model and cannot reconstruct the original DFT displacement map.
targets.next_discriminating_test: Obtain a citable first-principles benchmark contract, freeze its hashes, and independently implement a converged DFT calculation without consulting author numerical code.

inventory.scope_reason: The complete seven-page arXiv v3 PDF was audited through the embedded Supplemental Material and Supplement Figure 5.

items.scientific_object: Fully relativistic LDA displacement-dependent WSe2 valence-band maximum for AA-stacked WSe2/MoSe2
items.authored_reason: A fail-closed clean-room campaign boundary and independent-QE map assembler are executable, but the publication omits the exact first-principles inputs needed for a paper-exact map.

items.scientific_object: First-shell continuum moire potential over one triangular unit cell
items.authored_reason: Independently generated from Eq. (1) and the reported Fourier amplitude and phase.

items.scientific_object: Two-degree continuum moire bands and third-neighbor triangular tight-binding fit
items.authored_reason: Plane-wave bands and tight-binding overlay are independently generated from the disclosed continuum Hamiltonian.

items.scientific_object: Density of states versus hole filling and physical hole density
items.authored_reason: DOS and density mapping are generated from independently computed band eigenvalues.

items.scientific_object: Localized Wannier amplitude of the highest isolated moire band
items.authored_reason: Constructed from independently diagonalized isolated-band Bloch states with a declared phase gauge.

items.scientific_object: First-, second-, and third-neighbor hopping versus moire period/twist angle
items.authored_reason: Hopping coefficients are independently fitted across the moire-period sweep.

items.scientific_object: Screened Hubbard U0, U1, U2 and U0/t1 ratio versus moire period
items.authored_reason: Image-charge-screened Wannier projections and the inset ratio are independently evaluated.

items.scientific_object: Strong-coupling exchanges J1, J2, J3 and J2/J1 ratio versus moire period
items.authored_reason: Generated from the printed strong-coupling expansion and independently computed hopping/interactions.

items.scientific_object: Top-band energy contours and three-quarter-hole Fermi contour
items.authored_reason: The contour field is independently evaluated from the disclosed continuum band.

items.scientific_object: Mismatch-system first-shell moire potential for aligned WSe2/MoS2
items.authored_reason: Independently generated from the supplement's mismatch geometry and fitted potential parameters.

items.scientific_object: Aligned WSe2/MoS2 continuum bands and tight-binding overlay
items.authored_reason: The supplement band panel is independently generated from Eq. (6).

items.scientific_object: Mismatch-system hopping parameters versus moire period/twist angle
items.authored_reason: The hopping sweep is independently generated from the mismatch-system bands.

items.scientific_object: Mismatch-system screened interactions versus moire period/twist angle
items.authored_reason: The interaction sweep is independently generated from mismatch-system Wannier functions.
